div.div:
getAllCustomers() returns the repository list directly (no copy). Search routes are exact-match, case-sensitive lookups: findByFirstName (derived query) and findByJobTitleJPQL (@Query on jobTitle).
A missing id raises CustomerNotFoundException; the @RestControllerAdvice maps it to 404 with an ErrorResponse body (message + timestamp).
